title: Fraud Flags
seo: Order fraud flags for online store owners
meta: Unusual orders flagged and tagged in your store for a person to check before you ship. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Fraud flags that mark unusual orders for a person to check
overview: Chargebacks hurt small stores. We set up flags that mark orders worth a second look, such as mismatched billing and shipping countries, very large quantities, rushed shipping on first orders or many attempts from one address. Flagged orders are tagged in your store and sent to you with the reasons. A person decides whether to ship, hold or cancel.

faq: No. It only flags, and a person decides. We aim to keep false alarms low by testing on your past orders, and you can loosen or tighten any rule.
Does it replace Shopify Protect or my payment provider checks?
No. It works alongside them. Your payment provider has its own risk checks, and our flags add rules specific to your store and customers.
Can you promise it will stop fraud?
No. Flags help you notice risky orders earlier, but no system catches everything. Keep using your payment provider tools and good shipping practice.
